elements.text:
Set them in a checker: /bglass/z at the four corners and the middle, an /bOpal/z in each of the four gaps. You get five blocks back.

  To its owner the glass is not solid. You can see it, you can break it, and you can walk right through it. To everyone else it is a normal wall of glass.

  It remembers the one who /bplaced/z it, not the one who made it. So if you give some to a friend, the ones they place will still block you.

  Place it while /bcrouching/z and it will not look like glass at all. It copies the block underneath and wears that face instead. Everything else works the same, it just looks like stone, or wood, or whatever you set it on.

  Crouch and place one on glass that is already disguised and it copies that pane's disguise instead of turning back into glass, so a whole wall can wear the same face.

  It breaks into nothing unless you mine it with /bSilk Touch/z, the same as normal glass.
